actions.action: Review and merge the WP-004 pull request establishing the multi-page manual foundation.
prerequisites: CI green on the pull-request head SHA
Negative controls recorded in the pull request body
evidence_required: CI run bound to the head SHA
stop_conditions: Validator fails on the head SHA
A tracked page is missing from the staged artifact
Reviewer cannot reproduce the negative controls
actions.fallback: Close the pull request without merging; main is unaffected.

actions.action: Resequence or close issue #2 (WP-003) against the WP-004 structure, resolving the recorded state divergence.
actions.fallback: Leave both work packages open and keep the divergence explicitly recorded.

actions.action: Author the next stage page (Release) as WP-005, following the Assure page pattern.
prerequisites: Assure page accepted as the pattern
stop_conditions: The Assure pattern is rejected in review
actions.fallback: Revise the Assure pattern before writing further stages.

actions.action: Select GitHub Actions as the GitHub Pages publishing source.
prerequisites: Repository content approved for public access
stop_conditions: Pages environment permissions are not approved
actions.fallback: Leave the repository undeployed and continue local preview only.
